name: @job-tracker/desktop
description: Job Tracker desktop app (Electron + local SQLite)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web-export && node build.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run rebuild-native && electron-forge start
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run rebuild-native && electron-forge package
scripts.make: npm run build && npm run rebuild-native && electron-forge make
